7faa8655733ce23d861df818f1ab5fd073d0b1f1.summary: ASEC (AhnLab) report on BlueShell, an open-source backdoor written in Go that runs on Windows, Linux and Mac. The report describes its use in attacks on Korean companies and Thai broadcasting companies, with Windows and customised Linux variants. It links BlueShell to the China-based Dalbit group but says BlueShell's use by that group was not confirmed. Tools reported alongside include FRP, Frpc, fscan, Impacket and Venom. Attacks are inferred to date from at least September 2022.

It covers ransomware (named its Story of the Year), the xDedic underground marketplace for hacked server credentials, SWIFT-enabled bank heists including the Bangladesh Central Bank case, the BlackEnergy attack on Ukraine's energy sector, the ProjectSauron espionage group, the ShadowBrokers data dumps, the IoT botnet used against Dyn, APT use of unpatched and zero-day flaws, financial and mobile adware malware, and a 2016 survey on how slowly businesses detect breaches.
